assay_run.method: Dual-color immunofluorescence of Pol II Ser5P and Ser2P in fixed ESC46C cells, acquired with a 100× oil-immersion objective (NA 1.49). Three-dimensional image stacks were used to quantify nuclear signals and Pol II clusters. This aggregate represents the Figure 1 uninduced reference and 12-h RHB-A condition; Figure 1 reports two independent experimental repeats, without assigning preparation-level repeat identities here. Repository content: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19473110 contains the dataset and analysis scripts; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8013307 identifies the RHB raw-image dataset.
assay_run.platform: VisiTech iSIM super-resolution confocal microscope on Nikon Ti2-E

sample.biological_model: Sox1-GFP reporter mouse embryonic stem cells
sample.biological_source: Mouse ESC46C cell line, derived from E14tg2a
sample.sample_material: Fixed ESC46C cells from the uninduced reference culture maintained in serum-free ESGRO Complete Clonal Grade Medium with LIF. Methods report collection after 48 h; the archived dataset description lists controls collected at 24 and 48 h. The exact collection interval represented by the Figure 1 reference is unresolved. Requested Uninduced reference culture duration before collection: numerical value not reported; no quantitative condition row created.

sample.biological_model: Sox1-GFP reporter mouse embryonic stem cells undergoing early neuronal differentiation
sample.biological_source: Mouse ESC46C cell line, derived from E14tg2a
sample.sample_material: Fixed ESC46C cells collected 12 h after transfer to RHB-A neuronal induction medium.
